title: A refreshed mobile game and clearer geography questions
body:
MOBILE GAMEPLAY
- Phone map games have a full-height notebook, pinned question and guess inputs, and a visible status row.
- Switch between Ask, Guess, and Map; larger touch targets make navigation and map controls easier to use.

COUNTRY QUESTION UNDERSTANDING
- Improved interpretation of English and Polish questions combining geography, numeric comparisons, and membership conditions.
- Improved distinctions between current and historical membership and between broad Christian categories and individual denominations.
- Your daily question and guess limits are unchanged.

SUGGESTIONS AND CONTACT
- Send feedback, bug reports, data corrections, and feature ideas from the Suggestions and contact page.
- Guests and signed-in players can optionally include a name and email address. Direct email and GitHub options remain available.
